No page read here gives a zero-to-peak amplitude of an as-bonded beryllium face on CR-III 3/8-1.0 at the CR-1457 wrinkle wavelength. That wavelength was not computed on 032 and is not computed here.

A space-mirror or optical-bench sandwich with a measured cell-print depth was not opened. The space sandwich that was opened is the aluminum solar-concentrator coupon, not an optical bench. Publisher gates blocked a 2025 panel-unit abstract on this pass.
A text extract of the local HexWeb attributes brochure contains no telegraphing depth. This pass does not add a depth Hexcel did not print.
ER-1001 prints 0.5 to 1.6 milliradian on 3/8-inch cells and does not print the matching depth. The sine and the slope-times-cell sketches are labelled projections.

Leighton faces are 1 mm aluminum on a machined core. The ER-1001 faces are aluminum foil, 0.003 to 0.016 inch in the series, thinner than the lead sheets, and the core on the depth trace is 3/16 inch. Neither is S-200F or SR-200 on CR-III 3/8-1.0. Flatwise tension and the beryllium bond remain unprinted, so the 60 psi amplitudes stay an upper bound only if that F_c is real.
Treating the 0.20 mm honeycomb rms, or a per-foot shop bow, as the wrinkle component exceeds the needed amplitudes only by using the wrong spatial piece.
